template.instruction: 请把下面的已结算状态写成一段中文小说正文，180 到 260 字。必须写出【本回合变化】里的移动、时间推进、物品变化和人物变化；可以写细微动作、对白和视角人物的感受，但不得新增人物、物品、地点、事件、往事或承诺；不要逐条复述状态，不要写标题或列表。

hypotheses.statement: The v1 state-view user turn did not ask for prose, so the base instruct model recited state and stopped.
hypotheses.test: v2 adds only the fixed writing instruction above; same case/model/seeds/sampling/cap.
hypotheses.falsifiedBy: v2 still has 0 fact-qualified candidates with no reduction in time/personality omissions.

hypotheses.statement: The base checkpoint lacks sufficient narration training for this task.
hypotheses.test: If H1 is falsified, the next step is the existing lane-02 beats/product path or the product checkpoint, not a larger N.

hypotheses.evidenceAgainst: No v1 call reached the 240-token cap; outputs were 22-76 tokens; 4 realization clusters existed at temperature 0.45.
hypotheses.test: v2 keeps sampling identical, so a v2 improvement cannot be attributed to sampling.

hypotheses.evidenceAgainst: The missing time and personality sentences are absent from all six raw texts; this is not an empty-issues or keyword mismatch.
hypotheses.test: No rubric or checker change; 01 remains the owner.

hypotheses.statement: The 44 s gap between calls 3 and 4 was a runner/driver stall, not GPU work.
hypotheses.action: Runner now caps nvidia-smi at 2 s and records startedAtMs/endedAtMs/gapBeforeMs plus runWallMs. v2 must report whole wall time including gaps.

duplicateAndQualificationRules.inheritedFromV1: Same normalization, fingerprints, four homogeneous rules, complete-link clustering, ambiguity band, effectiveRepetition = 1 - distinctRealizationClusters/6 and qualifiedDistinctClusters count.
duplicateAndQualificationRules.factPerspective: Same 01 RUBRIC.md and reviewNarration; factQualified = no fact finding; readableQualified = pass only; pending never passes.

decisionRules.zeroQualified: If v2 has 0 fact-qualified candidates, stop N expansion. Report v1/v2 side by side and hand the failure to 02/06 with the exact omitted facts. Do not relax the rubric.
decisionRules.qualifiedGate: If v2 has >=2 fact-qualified non-homogeneous candidates, prepare b02 (five other categories) with the v2 template under a new preregistration, then run the paired N=1/2/4 arms.
decisionRules.noBenefitClaim: v2 alone is one case and cannot establish a best-of-N benefit; it can only establish that qualified candidates and non-homogeneous realizations are possible under this template.
decisionRules.noNExpansion: Do not increase N or add seeds to rescue v2.
